decision.rationale: All 442,368 q32 catalog PWP blocks and 42,467,328 signed lanes were independently formed from the exact four M41 I_KY_KX_O INT8 payloads and M338 q32 centers. Every lane fits signed12, every low8 plus signed-high4 reconstruction is exact, and every block narrow flag is equivalent to all 96 lanes fitting signed INT8. The 26,720-byte q32/O4 worst-case slot fits 32 KiB. Static narrow incidence is 25.3560%, but it is unweighted over catalog blocks and therefore authorizes only a runtime-used-center audit, not bytes, cycles, speedup, energy or system claims.

static_narrow_statistics.interpretation: This is an equal-weight static catalog statistic. It is not the narrow fraction of centers actually fetched by the frozen H67 runtime and is not a traffic-saving percentage.

encoding_proof.high4_rule: Interpret each four-bit nibble as signed two's complement, shift left by eight, then add unsigned low8.
encoding_proof.narrow_rule: A lane is narrow iff high4 equals the sign extension of low8 bit 7; a block is narrow iff this holds for all 96 lanes.

findings.title: Static catalog incidence is not runtime incidence
findings.detail: The 25.3560% rate gives every partition, q32 center and output block equal weight. Frozen runtime used-center frequency and center-run ordering can materially change fetched narrow/wide proportions.

findings.title: Worst-case slot fit does not itself save bytes
findings.detail: The 640-byte fixed center stride reserves each 160-byte block including high4 capacity. An elastic transfer needs a frozen flag/sidecar layout and command accounting before any runtime byte reduction exists.

findings.title: No RTL encoder, decoder or protocol evidence exists
findings.detail: Python proves arithmetic identities and exercises two mutations. VCS must still prove packed nibble order, flag timing, narrow/wide switching, stalls and malformed-sidecar rejection.

findings.title: M41 remains a local INT8 numeric bridge
findings.detail: The weights are checkpoint-bound, but dynamic no-running BatchNorm, ATLIF, requantization and full-network/valid825 accuracy are outside M41 and this audit.

findings.title: No physical or performance claim follows
findings.detail: There is no DMA-cycle recurrence, synthesized storage/control cost, SRAM macro, timing, SAIF/PTPX, energy, system speedup or DATE-headline evidence.

next_gate.name: H67_Q32_O4_RUNTIME_USED_CENTER_ELASTIC_WIDTH_AUDIT
required: weight every used center and output block by the frozen H67 q32 phase/run ledger
freeze flag, low8, optional high4 sidecar addresses and 32-byte command alignment

report bytes and cycles separately before considering RTL
